title: MapProgress
description: One run's progress over a WorldMap: where the player has been, what they have cleared, which rooms the blueprint may reveal, and whether the run is won. Play-time state, never part of the authored Adventure.

entered.description: Instances the player has set foot in, in order of first entry.

cleared.description: Instances whose goal has been met, in order of clearing.

visitedRooms.description: instanceId -> room ids the player has entered. What the blueprint overlay is allowed to draw.
